Job Description Summary
Job Description Summary
The Senior Manager, Client Services is a senior individual contributor responsible for managing Lucie’s most complex and strategic partner relationships across FMOs, agencies, carriers, and other distribution partners. This role leads high-impact client initiatives from sales handoff through launch, adoption, ongoing service, and renewal support, while serving as a senior escalation point for complex partner and delivery issues. The Senior Manager influences client service standards, cross-functional operating practices, and strategic priorities through expertise, judgment, and data-driven recommendations rather than direct people management. This role partners closely across Sales, Operations, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Training, Support, Finance, and Legal to improve partner outcomes and enable scalable growth.
Job Description
Job Description
Primary Duties and Responsibilities 
List, in order of importance, each job duty/ responsibility. It is recommended no more than 7 duties/responsibilities are listed, with no one responsibility being less than 10% of time spent. 

Own a portfolio of Lucie’s most complex and strategic partner relationships, including FMOs, agencies, carriers, and other distribution partners, from sales handoff through launch, adoption, ongoing service, and renewal support.
Serve as the senior client services subject matter expert and escalation point for complex partner needs, delivery risks, business tradeoffs, and executive-level communications and business reviews.
Develop and improve scalable client service standards, playbooks, escalation paths, success measures, partner-health metrics, and reporting based on recurring partner needs and operational insights.
Lead complex cross-functional partner initiatives across Sales, Operations, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Training, Support, Finance, and Legal; align requirements, owners, dependencies, risks, and decisions to support successful execution.
Analyze partner activation, adoption, service performance, retention, renewal, and expansion indicators to identify risks and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to business leaders.
Independently resolve complex partner and delivery issues, clarify tradeoffs, coordinate remediation, and escalate decisions when needed to protect client expectations, business commitments, and service outcomes.
Synthesize recurring partner feedback and service insights into recommendations that influence the product roadmap, onboarding and implementation processes, sales handoffs, training, support, and the overall partner experience.
Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations (DO NOT REMOVE - REQUIRED)
Other duties as assigned (DO NOT REMOVE - REQUIRED)
 
Required Experience and Education

Minimum levels to qualify for this job (Basic Qualifications or BQs): 
6+ years of experience in client services, client success, strategic account management, implementation, partner operations, or a related cross-functional role.
3+ years of experience independently managing complex client, partner, account, or implementation portfolios with responsibility for escalations, cross-functional execution, and senior stakeholder communication.
Experience owning complex external client or partner relationships and leading executive-level communications, escalations, and business reviews.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional launches, implementations, or service initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, risks, and business commitments.
Experience developing or improving client-service standards, playbooks, governance practices, KPIs, partner-health measures, or escalation processes.
Experience using client, service, adoption, or performance data to identify risks and opportunities, set priorities, and drive measurable improvements.
Experience presenting recommendations, performance, risks, and tradeoffs to senior or executive audiences and partnering across Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, or related functions.

Education:

Preferred Experience and Education

Preferred Qualifications (PQs) (a.k.a Nice to have):
Experience managing complex client services or strategic account portfolios in health insurance, employee benefits, insurtech, healthcare technology, or another regulated industry.
Experience managing strategic relationships with FMOs, agencies, brokers, carriers, or other insurance distribution partners.
Experience with ACA marketplace, EDE, ICHRA, supplemental products, producer onboarding, agency hierarchies, or book-of-business migrations.
Experience with SaaS platforms, CRM workflows, APIs, data imports, reporting, or operational integrations that support partner implementation and service delivery.
Experience leading executive business reviews, partner-health programs, renewal and retention planning, or expansion initiatives.
Experience scaling client services processes, playbooks, service standards, reporting, and cross-functional governance in a growing organization.

Job Profile Summary
A Group Product Manager leads a team of Product Managers and is focused on defining product strategy, identifying and prioritizing solutions, and leading cross-team execution for a given product domain.
The role works closely with partners across cross-functional teams to support Oscar’s vision, strategy, and roadmap for  technology investments 
The Group Product Manager and their team is responsible for becoming subject matter experts in their aligned business and product domain, understanding the challenges, needs and outcomes they are accountable to drive.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities
Helping to define the vision and strategy for a set of product domains, owning road maps focused on improving the operational processes, iterating and evolving provider data structures in the aligned product area
Partnering closely with stakeholders including cross functional department leaders across the business including Product, Design, Engineering, Business Development and Marketing to define strategy and roadmap
Collaborating with Engineering and Product leadership to make resource trade-off decisions and to ensure teams are working together effectively
Provide recommendations to leadership for product enhancements to improve existing products and development of new ones 
Develop operating models for new products in partnership with leadership 
Partner with +Oscar leadership, Marketing, and Comms to ensure +Oscar is positioned as a thought leader at key industry events
Mentoring, coaching and providing support to a team of Product Managers
Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations (DO NOT REMOVE - REQUIRED)
Other duties as assigned (DO NOT REMOVE - REQUIRED)
 
Required Experience and Education
7+ years of product experience
4+ years of people management experience
 
Preferred Experience and Education
Comfort in working in highly collaborative environments while ensuring the team is always driving towards a decision
Excellent analytical and quantitative skills; proved experience using data to identify opportunities, test theories and evaluate success.
Experience as an end-to-end thinker; the ability to look at a problem and create a solution all the way from top-level goals to smaller details
Ability to influence and manage stakeholders at all levels and experience working across all levels of leadership using strong communication and structured thinking
